title: Local eventual zero of higher-image sections
statement: Let Λ be an arbitrary commutative ring, k:W→S a scheme morphism and G a Λ-module sheaf on W_et [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let I be a small cofiltered category, D:I→Over W an inverse system with affine transitions and qcqs composite structure maps to S, and c a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting, with qcqs composite structure map to S. Fix q∈ℤ and an etale object V→S. Write G_i=D(i)^*G and G_c=c.pt^*G [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]; write t for the canonical higher-image transition of [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions], using higher images as in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For every i∈I and y∈(R^q(D(i)→S)_*G_i)(V) with t(c_i)(V)(y)=0, where V→S is any etale object, there is a covering sieve R on V such that for every arrow a:U→V in R there exist j∈I and f:j→i for which t(D(f))(U)(y|_U)=0. No affine assumption on V and no common stage for the whole covering are asserted.

proof.text: Choose a small directed final presentation of I^op. Its opposite is initial, so reindexing preserves the underlying scheme limit. After base change to an affine etale U over S, the stage schemes and limit are qcqs and the transitions affine. The coefficient diagram on the limit is canonically constant with value the pullback of G, by inverse-image composition, and its colimit is that value since I^op is nonempty and connected.

Use an injective module resolution and its underlying abelian-section acyclicity to compute abelian cohomology after forgetting scalars (03FD), without ring flatness. Apply continuity for degree-zero sheaves as complexes (0EZM) to each system of the preceding step. This gives cohomology-presheaf continuity on the affine basis; all maps are the canonical derived-unit maps, hence commute with restrictions and agree with t. The higher-image presheaf description (03Q8) and sheafification of presheaf colimits identify the limit higher image with the sheaf colimit of the stage higher images. For q<0 the resolutions have zero cohomology.

Use the sheafification description to lift the original section locally to cohomology representatives. Since its limit image vanishes, refine the cover so that those representatives vanish at the limit. Refine further by affine etale objects and apply cohomology continuity to kill each representative at a later stage. Negative cohomology is zero for the degree-zero coefficient sheaves. On an arrow factoring through a witnessing member, restriction and naturality preserve zero. This yields a covering sieve of local witnesses, without any finite subcover or common stage.

For an original stage i, finality gives an arrow from i to a reindexed stage in I^op. Apply the preceding vanishing argument there and compose arrows. In I this is f:j→i. Functoriality of derived units and inverse-image composition identifies its transition with t(D(f)), giving the required zero.

proof_origin.place: Local part of 09Z1 (lemma-relative-colimit), using 03Q8, 0EZM and 03FD; no finite-cover assembly

mathlib_searches.query: A higher direct image section vanishing at an inverse limit vanishes locally at later stages
A section of a filtered colimit of sheaves on a quasi compact object is zero if and only if it is zero at a later stage
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits concerning structure sheaves and affine scheme limits; none match module-valued higher images. Existing abelian local lemma requires a directed preorder and coefficient-system data.

Mathlib search returned no hits. Repository rg found HigherDirectImageLocalSectionVanishing, for abelian sheaves and directed preorders, which does not directly state this module-valued canonical-transition theorem.
